posts.title: [Advisory] Citrix NetScaler: RCE CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 Actively Exploited as Zero-Days
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on internet-facing edge appliances via network access.
- **Current exploitation status**: Actively Exploited

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Citrix NetScaler ADC
- Citrix NetScaler Gateway
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Attack Chain:** CVE-2026-88771 allows unauthenticated command execution on all deployments; CVE-2026-88772 enables RCE/DoS. Both independently exploited.
- **Prerequisites:** Network access to internet-facing NetScaler appliance; CVE-2026-88771 requires no extra features, CVE-2026-88772 requires DTLS enabled (default for VPN virtual servers).
- **Impact Details:** Patching alone may not remove attacker access gained pre-patch. Preserve forensic evidence before updating.
- **Available Mitigations:**   
 Vendor patches available; install as soon as possible.
    - Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway 14.1-73.37 and later releases
    - Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway 13.1-64.23 and later releases of 13.1
    - Citrix NetScaler ADC 14.1-FIPS 14.1-73.37 FIPS and later releases of 14.1-FIPS
    - Citrix NetScaler ADC 13.1-FIPS and 13.1-NDcPP 13.1.37.279 and later releases of 13.1-FIPS and 13.1-NDcPP

    - **Temporary:** implement broad geo IP restrictions.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-88771 CVSS4.0: 9.5 (CRITICAL) - Improper input validation enabling unauthenticated RCE; affects all deployments (actively exploited)

posts.title: [Advisory] Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager: API Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-76504)
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated attackers to gain admin-level API access remotely.
- **Current exploitation status**: Actively Exploited

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (all configurations)
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Attack Chain:** Improper URI encoding handling allows a crafted HTTP request (e.g., using an encoded character such as `%6a` in `j_security_check` as `/%6a_security_check`) to bypass authentication rules and access the API as admin (not limited to the  `%6a` -> `j` character) .
- **Prerequisites:** Network/remote access to the affected system's API; no authentication required.
- **Impact Details:** Attacker gains admin privileges; IOCs include suspiciously encoded `j_security_check` entries for `viptela-reserved-` accounts in service-proxy and vmanage-server logs.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor software updates available
    - Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Cloud Hosted environments already remediated
    - **additionaly :** Follow Cisco Hardening recommendations

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-76504 CVSS3.1: 9.8 (CRITICAL) - URI encoding authentication bypass granting admin API access

##### REFERENCES:
Primary:

posts.title: [Advisory] Microsoft Patch Tuesday September 2026
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation of the most severe flaws allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, or local attackers to elevate privileges to full SYSTEM control.
- **Current exploitation status**: Two zero-days actively exploited, others are unknown

##### NOTABLE CVEs

**CVE-2026-85880 - Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC) Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (Exploitation Detected)**
A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Windows ALPC allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.
An attacker who can execute code in a low-privilege AppContainer could exploit this vulnerability locally to escape the sandbox and gain SYSTEM privileges without additional user interaction.

**CVE-2026-81963 - Windows Update Stack Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (Exploitation Detected)**
An improper link resolution vulnerability in the Windows Update Stack allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.
Exploiting this defect allows an attacker to follow malicious links and overwrite system components with attacker-controlled files to gain SYSTEM privileges.

**CVE-2026-69829 - Windows Shell Remote Code Execution Vulnerability**
A critical remote code execution flaw in the Windows Shell can be exploited over a network.
This vulnerability can be exploited with low attack complexity, requiring no privileges and no user interaction to seize control of a vulnerable machine.

**CVE-2026-69730 - Windows DNS Remote Code Execution Vulnerability**
A critical DNS weakness present in Windows Server and Windows 10 allows an unauthenticated attacker to exploit the system over a network.
An attacker could leverage this weakness simply by sending a specially crafted packet to an affected system, and it is considered likely to be exploited.

**CVE-2026-80093 - Windows Cloud Files Mini Filter Driver Type Confusion Vulnerability (Proof of Concept Available)**
A type confusion vulnerability exists in the CldiStreamPrepareRequestForMoreProcessing functionality of the Windows Cloud Files Mini Filter Driver.
An attacker can execute a dedicated application to trigger this vulnerability, leading to an arbitrary write and potentially arbitrary code execution.

**CVE-2026-55007 - Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability**
A double free vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network without authentication.

posts.title: [Advisory] Magento / Adobe Commerce: Unauthenticated RCE Zero-Day actively exploited (CVE-2026-75650 - StyleSmuggler)
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution and establish persistent backdoors on affected e-commerce servers via network access.
- **Current exploitation status**: Actively Exploited

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Adobe Magento / Adobe Commerce (impact not yet confirmed by Adobe)
- All current versions are reportedly affected, including the latest release. 
- 
##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:

- **Prerequisites:** Network access to the store; GraphQL endpoint reachable (primary observed attack vector).
- **Impact Details:** Deploys a Rust implant disguised as a legitimate process (`[kworker/u:8:0]` or `fc-cache`), persisted via cron entries that restart every few minutes and re-add themselves within a second of removal.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - No official vendor patch available; Adobe's next scheduled release is September 8.
    - **Temporary:** Temporarily disable GraphQL until a fix is released; add `proc_open` to PHP `disable_functions`; mount `/tmp`, `/var/tmp`, `/dev/shm` with `noexec`; deploy unofficial community patches (Disrex, ProxiBlue, Graycore) and web-server query-string filtering rules; run eComscan (v1.9.7+) with a scan path above the document root.

posts.title: [Advisory] Kaltura mwEmbed: Unauthenticated RCE and Arbitrary File Read
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files and execute arbitrary commands as the web server user via network access to the `mwEmbedLoader.php` endpoint.
- **Current exploitation status**: Proof of Concept Available

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Kaltura HTML5 Player Library (mwEmbed / html5lib)
- Kaltura Server deployments exposing `mwEmbedLoader.php`, including shared multi-tenant CDN infrastructure
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** Network access to `mwEmbedLoader.php`; no authentication, session token, or user interaction required. RCE requires default file-based cache backend.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - No vendor patch available
    - **Temporary:** Block `mwEmbedLoader.php` at WAF/reverse proxy/CDN; restrict outbound network access; reject non-`http(s)` `ServiceUrl`; deny PHP execution in cache directories.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-19912 CVSS3.1: 10.0 (CRITICAL) - Unsafe deserialization and path traversal leading to unauthenticated RCE
- CVE-2026-19913 CVSS3.1: 9.1 (CRITICAL) - `ServiceUrl` `file://` scheme enables arbitrary local file read

##### REFERENCES:
Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://kb.cert.org/vuls/id/308749

Supporting:
- Technical Analysis: https://anddone-git.github.io/2026/one-parameter-two-bugs/

posts.summary: Two unauthenticated vulnerabilities in Kaltura’s mwEmbed/html5lib video player allow remote attackers to read arbitrary files and execute arbitrary code. The flaws stem from an undocumented `ServiceUrl` parameter that controls a server-side fetch and an unsafe PHP `unserialize()` operation.
